svg.title: MOD-17473 · Native OSS cluster · cluster-total memory
svg.desc: Paired absolute memory deltas for full equal-row-work cases. Cluster totals are same-sample sums across both primaries.
svg.text: MOD-17473 · Native OSS cluster · cluster-total memory
Full equal-row-work only. Cluster totals are same-sample sums across both primaries. Peak and final cooldown are relative to pre-load; positive means more PR memory.
Per case: 10 baseline/PR pairs = 20 fresh two-primary topology observations = 40 Redis process executions.
This figure: 120 pairs / 240 topology observations / 480 Redis processes. Whole campaign: 180 pairs / 360 topology observations / 720 Redis processes.
paired effect + 95% order-stratified whole-pair bootstrap CI
Cluster total · Process proportional set size (PSS)
Effects are medians of paired PR−baseline MiB deltas; cooldown may be negative and positive means more PR memory.
50 ms sampler ticks; allocator sampled about every 100 ms and PSS about every 200 ms. The sampler shares one load-generator physical core symmetrically.
RSS remains in JSON but is omitted from figures because process sums double-count shared pages. CIs: 10,000 order-stratified whole-pair resamples.
